rules.instruction: Match the exact product generation, variant, color and visible parts against actual reference photos. Never substitute another product or claim an unverified reconstruction is exact.

All food follows the user-approved docs/references/food-storyboard-approved-v1.png direction: verified interest hook, varied ingredients/texture, unboxing/preparation, applicable storage/serving, CTA. Use 6-8 cuts with visibly different subjects, actions and compositions; at most one cross-section shot, never a sequence of similar food beauty shots. Adapt steps to each food, not mandatory strawberries or freezing. Match narration to visible actions and verified handling instructions. Show the actual product/pack during storage, never unrelated ice packs. Preserve exact food/packaging; generated storyboard is a concept reference, not verified product footage. Do not invent virality, ingredients or tasting.
Every regeneration creates a new immutable Preview or Video version. Preserve previous assets, provenance and publication records.
Durable FIFO video queue with progress and no automatic retry of interrupted paid requests. Titles open detail. User approval is required for PUBLIC publication only, after private upload and review.

Codex must find the exact product and option on Coupang before recommending. Verify official brand/authorized seller evidence and Rocket Delivery independently, recording seller, option, evidence and check time. Do not substitute Rocket Jikgu or seller Rocket, infer official status from delivery, or fabricate unavailable links. Keep reference URLs separate from purchase URLs. Affiliate links must be issued through the user account after enrollment, never invented. Recheck availability before publication.

At 09:00, 15:00 and 21:00 KST each prepare one new item and privately upload one completed video; three per day across categories. GPT-6 Astra directly researches trends and authors 6-8 cuts after verified Coupang data and affiliate links. No Gemini planning. Official video OR images required. Need -> solution -> evidenced popularity/interest reasons -> product features -> fixed Korean pinned-comment/channel-profile CTA. Never invent popularity. No 3D model creation.

For food revisions use browser-operated Flow Veo with existing credits; no Veo API fallback. Preserve official exact food/product sources; validate reference-guided package actions frame by frame. Discard original audio and retain the category voice. Never present invented shape or a method illustration as actual product footage.

Automatically produce and inspect completed videos, then computer-use upload to @GumaShop86 PRIVATE only. Verify actual visibility and record URL/hash. Only the exact version explicitly approved by the user may become public. Never infer public approval from creation or private upload.

Follow categories.py: food uses Maplestory, strawberry-accent readable captions and static product stills without zoompan jitter. Other categories retain their style. Food uses Zephyr, a bright friendly female voice; tech and household retain Achird. All are naturally brisk. Keep captions out of product focal areas and retain ad/disclosure readability.

Before selection inspect actual YouTube Studio uploads for the last seven days, including private videos, and local upload events. Record topic_key, problem_key, and per-video novelty comparisons. Reject similar subject/problem even for different products. One tech at 09:00, food at 15:00, household at 21:00 KST.

Target 20-40; verified tech option <= KRW500000. Original resolution gate and 1080x1920 no letterbox. Each narration must match visible action: thawing on a room-temperature counter, storage in a freezer, no unrelated beauty shot. Max two uses of identical source, never adjacent; inspect visual similarity too. Veo: candid photorealistic, bright diffused natural light, low contrast, no cinematic shadows or posing. 0.2s dissolves preserving spoken endings. No top-left branding. Persistent top-right [광고], affiliate disclosure in description first line and beside links; YouTube AI-use setting enabled for realistic generated scenes. No routine burned-in affiliate or AI captions. Keep [광고]; all captions use outlines, no background boxes. Label virtual-person endorsements or omit those scenes. Review frames, motion, captions and disclosure before private upload. If hearing is unavailable, honestly retain audio as user-review-pending on private YouTube; user authorized category voices and private review. Never fabricate listening. Public release requires explicit version approval.

feedback.lesson: Replace promotional excerpts with a need-led hook and evidence-based solution narrative. Remove inaccurate model stage; preserve actual product sources. Private upload precedes user public approval.

User approved the seven-cut strawberry-mochi storyboard on 2026-10-05 as the standard for ALL food products. Diversify the story through ingredients, hands, preparation and serving rather than repeated cross-sections. Keep bright soft realism, legible Pretendard captions, static stills and smooth transitions; adapt to verified product facts.

affiliate_browser_policy.authorization: Use the user-maintained signed-in Coupang Partners session to issue links before API integration.
affiliate_browser_policy.on_auth_required: Pause affected work and ask user to log in or complete verification. Never bypass authentication.
affiliate_browser_policy.on_connection_unavailable: Report browser connection issue separately; do not assume login expired.
affiliate_browser_policy.notification: Notify actionable changes; avoid repeating unchanged blockers.

youtube_upload_policy.approval: Automatic private upload after audio/visual review is authorized. Public transition requires explicit per-version user approval.
youtube_upload_policy.verification: Confirm active channel and existing upload before submitting; record video URL and state to prevent duplicates. Do not invent publication schedule.
youtube_upload_policy.auth: Ask user only when login or verification is required; distinguish browser disconnection. Never bypass authentication.
youtube_upload_policy.browser: Use connected in-app browser first; use Chrome if required capabilities are unavailable. Verify each browser session independently.

publishing.schedule: 09:00 tech, 15:00 food, 21:00 household Asia/Seoul; one per category daily
publishing.workspace: Production and editing workspace: preserve final per-cut videos with narration, identify by idea ID/video version/cut number, process edit_requests as new versions. User reviews final video on YouTube; only private-to-public remains after approval.
publishing.cta: 영상 속 제품 정보는 고정댓글이나 채널 프로필에서 확인하세요.
publishing.pinned_comment: Store product name, issued affiliate URL and disclosure; include profile product number only after actual registration. Private videos cannot have comments; keep pending until public, never claim posted. Shorts comment URLs are not clickable.

caption_policy.disclosure_location: description first line and affiliate links; YouTube AI-use setting
caption_policy.exception: Label virtual-person endorsements or omit them; do not present generated performance as actual evidence.
